title: Rav Yosef bar Dosai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Chullin 49a, disputing with the sages. Hyman reports the Dikdukei Soferim reading Abba Yose ben Dostai, whom Hyman places among the last Tannaim, as explained in his entry.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman contrasts the heading Rav Yosef bar Dosai with Abba Yose ben Dostai, attributing the latter reading to דק״ס, conventionally Dikdukei Soferim. Abba, Yose and ben Dostai are retained as a different cited name form; the description as a late Tanna is Hyman’s.
Chullin 49a follows the printed מט. locator. The supplied text ends with a comma; that punctuation alone does not establish that further words are missing.
